seo.metaTitle: DHA Multan Map — Master Plan of Phase 1, All Sectors on Satellite
seo.metaDescription: DHA Multan master plan on the satellite map: every sector from A to Y, B1, E1, E2, W1, W2, Rumanza, DHA Villas, Central and Pakistan Square, and the gates.
seo.intro: DHA Multan Phase 1 master plan — every sector (A to Y, B1, E-1, E-2, W1, W2), Rumanza Golf Community, DHA Villas, the avenues, parks, Central Square and Pakistan Square — DHA Multan's own plan laid on the satellite map. See the properties listed in DHA Multan and find a plot on site with your live location.
seo.content: This is DHA Multan's provisional master plan; DHA Multan confirms the location of plots on its sector maps and may change the town planning. For a plot's final position, check with the DHA Multan office (061-111-111-189).

faqs.q: Which sectors are in DHA Multan Phase 1?
faqs.a: Sectors A, B1, C, D, E, E-1, E-2, F, G, H, I, K, L, M, N, O, P, Q, R, S, T, U, V, W1, W2, X and Y, with the Rumanza Golf Community in the north and DHA Villas by the Jinnah Gate.

faqs.q: Where are the gates of DHA Multan?
faqs.a: Jinnah Gate on Bosan Road in the west, Iqbal Gate on Multan Public School Road in the south, Liaquat Ali Gate on Mattital Road in the south-east and Fatima Jinnah Gate in the east, towards the N-5 and the Motorway.

faqs.q: What are the main roads of DHA Multan?
faqs.a: Muhammad Ali Jinnah Avenue runs east–west through the middle, Allama Muhammad Iqbal Avenue north–south from Rumanza to Central Square, and Fatima Jinnah Avenue goes east from Pakistan Square.
